  ! This let declares a variable that is only assigned once.

      │ ^^^
    2 │ debugger;
    3 │ export const b = a;
  
  i 'a' is never reassigned.
  
  > 1 │ let a = 1;
      │     ^
    2 │ debugger;
    3 │ export const b = a;
  
  i Safe fix: Use const instead.
